_meta.description: Scheme register for the CPC regional intelligence map. One record per scheme. First compiled 14 November 2026 from board papers (read directly) and public sources (web).
_meta.notes: Coordinates are approximate and must be checked during the build (see brief). value_gbp_m is only filled where a single headline figure is clear; otherwise see value_note. confidence = how well the record is supported: high (primary paper read), medium (official or trade press), low (secondary or AI-generated summary; verify).
